description: Fork of exp593 (1.4337 SoTA, read_out NAP=5). SINGLE change: qk_lut tph 256 -> 512 (double tables, NAP stays at 4). Atoms/layer 24K -> 49K, per-dim input pair coverage 32 -> 64 uses/dim (the 'narrowest input coverage of any module' observation), mixture depth on qk output 256 -> 512, per-row gradient coverage UNCHANGED at 512 tokens/row (both tph and rows double together). qk_lut params 3.15M -> 6.29M per layer = 18.87M -> 37.75M total (+18.87M). Bandwidth per layer 6.29 -> 12.58 Mbits = 37.7 -> 75.5 Mbits trunk (+37.7 Mbits, +24% trunk). Total ~280M params, ~193 Mbits trunk, ~596 Mbits total. Tests whether the 32-uses-per-dim input coverage at qk was actually limiting routing quality, or whether qk_lut was input-saturated.
